'''Aemin''' is a farrier from [[Cairhien]] who travels with [[Perrin Aybara]].

==Appearance==
Aemin is a broad and stocky man with graying hair.{{ref/book|8|9}}

==Activities==
Given his nationality, it is likely Aemin was hired after Perrin and Rand return from the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]] and before Perrin Travels to [[Ghealdan]].

Aemin is one of the farriers who look after [[Stepper]] and [[Stayer]], despite Perrin wanting to do the work himself.{{ref/book|8|9}} Aemin then travels with the group to [[Malden]] to rescue [[Faile Bashere]].{{ref/book|9|6}} Aemin, [[Falton]] and [[Jerasid]] are working the night Faile meets with [[Alliandre Maritha Kigarin]], [[Arrela Shiego]] and [[Lacile Aldorwin]].{{ref/book|12|21}}

He is working the forges when Perrin relieves him from duty and creates ''[[Mah'alleinir]]''.
